name: hero-immersive
title: Immersive hero
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A full-bleed photograph or artwork with the headline, lede and actions set in white over a contrast-safe gradient scrim.

meta.useWhen: There is a striking, high-quality photograph or artwork of the real place, product or experience.
meta.avoidWhen: The image is a stock photo, low resolution, or bright across the bottom third. Use hero-split, which frames the image beside the text.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/HeroImmersive.astro. It breaks out of a centered column and clips the page's horizontal overflow.
